request.deadline: Three-month staged liquidity deployment after enactment, with monthly reporting; administrator confirmation expected within 30 days of enactment.
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with transparent safety mechanisms and reserve-ratio rules
Composable Cardano-native FIRE and ICE assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Public dashboards showing reserve ratio, asset supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Legal, compliance, disclosures, treasury reporting, and risk documentation
Go-to-market execution, ecosystem education, DRep communications, partner activation, and launch coordination
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer by Sundial Protocol and Charms.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference value for an approximately USD 2.0 million planning budget.

The budget is split into approximately USD 1.0 million for protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity and approximately USD 1.0 million for delivery, audit, integrations, dashboards, governance reporting, legal/compliance work, and go-to-market execution.
Alchemy will create a shared BTC reserve architecture where FIRE and ICE are backed by the same BTC reserve, with reserve-ratio formulas and safety zones governing minting, redemption, and pauses.

FIRE is described as a volatility-absorbing residual BTC-backed claim, while ICE is described as lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed exposure intended for wallet, DEX, dashboard, and DeFi integration.
Launch liquidity will be treasury-supported and treasury-owned, with profits, yield, and returns returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly through disclosed conversion and reporting processes.

The launch-liquidity principal may be returned after Alchemy reaches a 30-day time-weighted average TVL of at least USD 60 million, subject to a later formal governance proposal for DRep and Constitutional Committee review.

The proposal includes treasury protections such as fund separation, milestone gating, pause rules, refund conditions, ADA price protection above USD 0.35, and a rollover commitment if external investment funds development.

Intersect is proposed as interim fund administrator, but its role is subject to confirmation and final agreement, with an alternative independent administrator to be nominated if Intersect does not confirm within 30 days of enactment.
The proposal states that Charms provides Bitcoin/Cardano compatibility infrastructure and the technical foundation for issuing Bitcoin-native assets that can circulate as Cardano-native assets.

The proposal asserts that Cardano lacks a serious production BTCfi infrastructure layer and that failure to fund Alchemy would leave Bitcoin-backed structured exposure to consolidate on other chains and off-chain capital markets.

summary: The document requests 10,000,000 ada for a staged, milestone-gated BTCfi infrastructure and launch-liquidity program centered on BTC-backed FIRE and ICE assets, with proposed treasury protections, reporting, audits, administrator oversight, and return mechanisms.
